title: Residual Centering and Error Bounds for Convex Approximation of Mixed-Integer Recourse
summary: We study convex approximations of mixed-integer recourse functions in two-stage stochastic programming. For first-stage decisions, the relevant approximation error is the signed expected residual between the convex approximation and the integer-recourse value function. On bounded uncertainty boxes, we identify residual conditions that yield deterministic bounds for this expectation error.
